visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white vest over a light-colored top, sits in a well-lit indoor room. A large yellow painting and a small desk lamp are in the background. She holds a giant brown cardboard box with red tape. (2) She uses her hands to rip open the cardboard box, leaning forward. A red inner box is revealed. She pulls out a smaller red blind box labeled 'THE MONSTERS'. (3) She shows the back of the box to the camera, pointing at the graphics. She then lifts the entire set of six boxes. (4) She opens one of the individual blind boxes, pulling out a white plush Labubu toy encased in a transparent plastic mold. Her expression is highly enthusiastic with a wide smile. (5) She holds the white Labubu close to the camera, showing a red Santa hat and a small Coca-Cola bottle accessory. The background lighting is warm. (6) She switches to a second white Labubu, this one wearing a red scarf and holding a red Coca-Cola can. She turns it around to show a QR code tag attached to its ear. (7) She proceeds to open more boxes rapidly, revealing more white plushies. She poses with two white Labubus at the end, waving at the camera.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long black hair, bangs, wearing a cream-colored top with a white knit vest. She wears small gold hoop earrings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic indoor setting with a large minimalist painting featuring green and yellow shapes. There is a wooden desk with a small lamp and some stationery items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience. Fast-paced, bright electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat begins. (2) Harsh paper tearing SFX as a cardboard box is ripped. Vocal intensity remains high with high arousal. (3) A lower-volume second female voice (off-camera) joins the dialogue. Metallic/hollow thudding sound from the large box moving. (4) Crinkling plastic bag rustle SFX and a sharp 'click' from a plastic container opening. (5) Fast-tempo speech describing product details. BGM remains constant with high spectral brightness. (6) Repeated plastic rustling SFX as multiple blind boxes are handled. (7) High-pitched vocal exclamation 'Oh!' followed by rapid-fire speech. (8) Soft rubbing sound (frictional noise) as fingers touch plush fabric. (9) Final high-energy vocal outro with a 'ding' sound effect for emphasis.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Unboxing -> Detail Reveal -> Giveaway Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to build excitement and showcase the new Pop Mart x Coca-Cola Labubu plush series. It uses high-energy unboxing to engage collectors and ends with a follower-rewarding giveaway to drive social engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Pop Mart packaging and product unboxing with verbal recommendation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media editing with variety-show style captions and sound effects to maintain viewer attention.
